Title: Data Factory adds management hub, inline datasets, and support for CDM in data flows

Body.Content:
• Azure Synapse Analytics workspace and ADF now have a new Management Hub UI to provide a single place to manage connections & triggers. 
  • Data Flows now allow inline datasets as part of your source and sink transformation definitions. This allows for more flexible formats in ADF including Common Data Model (CDM) which is now in public preview in ADF.

Learn more.

Azure Synapse Analytics workspace and ADF now have a new Management Hub UI to provide a single place to manage connections & triggers.
